text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a certain day off—
I decided to have lunch out to unwind, but the menu
was lined with nothing but confusing foreign words.

Heh, you look like you're not
used to French cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone called out from the next table,
so I turned around to seeâ

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You don't get the menu, do ya? Want me to break it down for ya?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But all I'm doing is teaching.
Whether you get a good meal out of it is entirely on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a certain nuance behind those words.
Should I ask for guidance...?
choice_data_list: Do my best on my own

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Is that so. Well, good luck with that.
Hope it works out for ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, when I tried ordering food on my own—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, it's all vegetable dishes?!
You really know your stuff, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't make such a sad face.
Meals are meant to be enjoyed, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll give ya a hand.
Here, pass me the plates.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Cleaned my plate.
It was pretty tasty, but――

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Eating nothing but veggies is boring as hell. It ain't satisfying at all.
Hey, don't you think so too?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: For instance, right now, standing before me... looking so soft—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, haha, hahaha!
Don't be so on guard.
It's not like I'm gonna eat ya alive.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...For now, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, what an honest, good girl.
Then let's start with the appetizer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that said, Sirius Symboli placed the order for me
while explaining what everything meant.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Appetizer, soup, and main course. That's a pretty well-balanced meal, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Thank you"?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now... Isn't it a bit early
to be thanking me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I could even process what was happening, Sirius Symboli began moving the dishes that had just been served over to her own table.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A shame, but I was merely demonstrating the technique.
Which means this dish belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't make that face!
...It just makes me wanna tease you even more, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Alright, try ordering on your own this time.
I'll be watching closely
to see if you've gotten any wiser.
